query: Map the execution path from loop-engineering.yaml to its subrecipes and agents. Read only.
expected_skill_contribution: Should produce an evidence-backed map while stopping when additional exploration has low information value.
expected_behavior: Remains read-only and makes no repository or Beads mutations.
Identifies all four recipes and the three delegated agents with exact paths.
Reads no more than 12 files and explains why each was selected.
Returns a smallest plausible implementation boundary for one improvement.

query: Trace the blast radius of changing the verifier verdict enum to add DEFERRED. Read only.
expected_skill_contribution: Should trace schema, skill, agent, recipe, docs, and eval impacts without broad scanning.
expected_behavior: Traces every explicit verdict enum and textual contract reference.
Lists affected paths with rationale and distinguishes required from optional changes.
Does not edit files or propose unrelated redesign.
Stops after evidence saturation and reports unresolved unknowns.

query: Investigate why a controlled loop repeatedly reaches REWORK without progress. Produce a diagnostic packet, no edits.
expected_skill_contribution: Should combine run state, evidence, task contract, and repository inspection to identify whether the problem is framing, implementation, or verification.
expected_behavior: Builds a chronology from Beads state events, comments, and evidence records.
Detects repeated failure signatures and identifies whether new evidence appeared.
Classifies root cause as task framing, implementation, verification, external blocker, or unknown.
Recommends exactly one next transition with evidence.

query: Research a reported regression where tests were added after the last failed attempt; determine whether the new evidence materially changes the next action without editing files.
expected_skill_contribution: The agent contract enforces bounded recovery, changed-hypothesis retries, and a typed handoff.
expected_behavior: Compares the prior failure signature with later-added evidence.
States whether the hypothesis materially changed.
Returns a bounded contract or WAIT/REPLAN without editing.
